scope: Only parsePlayer() and its existing parser tests edited by catalog_sources. Other working changes in stream()/integration tests belong to root and are not part of this ownership.
assertions: Expired preferred AAC falls through to fresh AAC of the exact same response video ID, with correct selected size/expiry.
All eligible expired/nearly-expired encodings retain the response expiration error.
A healthy higher-quality AAC retains priority and the existing one-minute expiry margin.
Expired tagged encodings still contribute to the response-wide original-audio requirement; dubbed or unconfirmed fresh siblings are rejected.
limitations: No provider network or media was requested by these tests.
No build, recipe generation, publication or commit.
Whole-module audit hash may later change through root-owned stream work; function snapshot is immutable.
